text_block_list.text:
After the concert ended, the fans in the 
venue were moved to tears. The feelings 
Mihono Bourbon poured into her performance 
had certainly reached them.

Just like the Smart Falcon she had seen 
before, she was able to deliver a live 
performance that "conveyed her feelings." 
The members' morale was soaring high.

As their activities unfolded, voices arose 
projecting their own dreams onto the Grand 
Live. On the other hand, dissenting 
opinions were heard as well.
